resources.string:
Turn an RPG Maker XP, VX or VX Ace fangame (like the ones made with Pokémon Essentials) into its own app, right from your phone. No PC, JoiPlay or Kirin needed: each game becomes an app with its own name, icon and its author's signature.

It uses the same engine as RMXP-Android-Ports (mkxp-z): the game really runs, there is no emulated Windows.

Still in development. If something fails, save the log and report it on GitHub.
You need the PC game files: the folder with Game.ini, or the .zip as you downloaded it. It is copied into this app; the original is not touched.
The file as you downloaded it
Game.ini not found. Choose the game folder (or a .zip that has it).
Taken from the game and its Readme. The author goes into the app\'s signature; type it if it is missing.
Pictures and music are read from the APK instead of being copied
The APK is put together with the ready-made engine, signed in the author\'s name and installed.
